# Clearcast

> Cursor agent skills for CLEAR blog publishing, SPARK editorial passes, SNAP/PULSE social casting, ORBIT multi-surface discovery, Studio Desk ops, and Cue Deck prompts.

MIT License. Canonical repo: https://github.com/dranshrad/clearcast
Docs site: https://dranshrad.github.io/clearcast/

## Skills

- skills/clearcast/SKILL.md — orchestrator
- skills/blog-engine/SKILL.md — CLEAR long-form + SEO/AEO modes
- skills/editorial-pass/SKILL.md — SPARK + voice canon
- skills/social-cast/SKILL.md — social creation + analytics
- skills/orbit-discovery/SKILL.md — ORBIT strategy
- skills/studio-desk/SKILL.md — workspace ops
- skills/cue-deck/SKILL.md — prompt cards
